description: Land Title Settlement Department - Narampola, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420214
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, owners' names, land extents, and title classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
